featured_reviews.review_text:
🌟IITians Science Point has been one of the best decisions of my JEE journey. The teaching methods are simple yet effective, making even tough concepts easy to understand.
A big thanks to Imtiyaz Sir—he has always been more than just a teacher for me. From academics to personal life and career guidance, he supported me at every step.Truly grateful!

featured_reviews.name: Khan Mariyam.
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s honestly only Ankit Sir, Rahul Sir, and Deepak Sir who stayed consistent and genuinely taught well throughout the year. The rest of the teachers seemed like they were forced to teach or were simply passing time. The start of 11th grade and the demo lectures were impressive – clearly designed just to pull students in. But once admissions were done, it felt like most teachers disappeared or stopped caring.

Imtiyaz Sir – the so-called "head" – is a sweet manipulator. He frequently arrived 1–2 hours late or canceled classes altogether (because, well, he’s the head and can do whatever he wants).

You might wonder why there are so many good reviews? Let me be honest – we were told to write them. Imtiyaz Sir himself said: “The more good reviews I see with your name, the more extra learning books I’ll provide.”
So yeah, that's how reviews were bought.

And let’s talk about the "toppers"? Even they admit they studied from YouTube. So if you want to lower your confidence, question your life decisions, and waste precious time and money – welcome to ISP.

This review is not exaggerated – it’s exactly what many of us genuinely felt. My NEET journey was made hell by this institute.

ALSO THIS CLASSES MADE A FAKE ACCOUNT OF MY NAME JUST BECAUSE THEY COULDN'T CLARIFY THEIR MISTAKES....I am an actual student of ISP where I "suffered" 2yrs and if it's not a fake account, darling there's not just one Mariyam on the planet.

featured_reviews.name: Paresh Gujarathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was a JEE student at ISP for about two years, and based on my experience, the faculty and staff are very approachable. They address concerns and resolve issues quickly and effectively. I had many questions about college admissions and the entrance exam process, and both Imtiyaz Sir and Harpreet Sir took the time to arrange one-on-one sessions to guide me personally.

At first, I was hesitant to appear for the entrance exam. However, every faculty member supported me throughout my preparation journey. With regular doubt-solving sessions, a variety of DPPs, test sheets, and question banks, they helped me shift my mindset, giving me clarity and motivation to move forward. I decided to give it a try and hoped for the best.

Eventually, I scored well in my JEE and applied to several colleges across India. I received offer letters from four institutes and was also selected by one of the most prestigious colleges in Maharashtra.

featured_reviews.name: harshita thakur
featured_reviews.review_text:
There is no elevator to success. You must take the stairs one small step at a time, and IITians Science Point will assist and guide you throughout your competitive exam journey.

The best IIT-JEE and NEET preparation academy in Mira Bhayandar. It provides us with an extra library and discussion room. All the faculties here are IITians and NITians.

They have their own application which helps students study at home too.

All the teachers are very good at teaching and they explain the concepts very well.

If you are serious about your preparation then ISP can actually take you to your dream institute.

Highly Recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjana Bhunia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a student at IITians Science Point for the past three years. I appeared for NEET in both 2024 and 2025, and all my preparation was done entirely through this institute.

In my honest opinion, success in competitive exams like NEET and JEE depends majorly on the student. Teachers play a significant but partial role—around 20–30%—by guiding students with the syllabus, teaching effective methods, and providing practice questions. However, the rest is entirely up to the student—how they absorb information, manage their time, simplify complex concepts for themselves, and stay consistent in their efforts.

I say this from personal experience. Scoring 94% in class 10 gave me confidence, but in my first NEET attempt, I secured a rank of 1.16 lakh. That was a reality check. Being a good student in school doesn’t guarantee continued success unless you evolve with the pressure and expectations that follow. Some students handle that pressure well, others may not—but your journey ultimately depends on your dedication and how sincerely you work for your own future.

A genuine review of the coaching:

The faculty at IITians Science Point is top-notch. Every teacher is selected after rigorous testing and demo sessions. Most of them come from prestigious backgrounds—doctors, IITians, NITians, and other reputed institutions. Their focus is not just on completing the syllabus but on ensuring students truly understand the concepts and can solve problems confidently.

Weekly tests are taken very seriously here. Because there are multiple tests, certain types of questions are often repeated, which helps students recognize and learn from their past mistakes. Batches are well-organized, and the regular lectures keep the momentum going throughout the year.

Despite the vast syllabus, the teachers make sure it is covered on time, with proper conceptual clarity. Special mention to Imtiyaz Sir—the head and physics faculty—who creates a very supportive environment. He not only helps us academically but also personally guides us through challenges and stands by us at every step.

For students who miss any topics, revision sessions are provided after the syllabus is completed. The coaching center is continuously working on improving all aspects of its functioning to provide the best possible support.

In the end, it's your own hard work that will define your success. No system is perfect—but with the right support and your determination, you can definitely move closer to your goal.

featured_reviews.name: Shravani Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Shravani Patil from the MR NEET 2025 batch. I studied at IITians Science Point for the past two years, and my overall experience has been really good. The faculty here is knowledgeable and approachable. They clear our doubts patiently and guide us at every step of the preparation.

The management is supportive and addresses even our smallest issues quickly, making sure we’re comfortable in our study environment. I’d like to give a special mention to Imtiyaz Sir, who has been a constant source of guidance – right from the beginning till even after the results. His dedication towards every student is truly commendable.

All the teachers here genuinely try their best to help us achieve our goal. They are very dedicated and motivating as well.

featured_reviews.name: Jai Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Jai Parmar from Batch 26, currently preparing for JEE 2026. I would like to share my experience and express my gratitude towards the institute and its exceptional faculty.

Firstly, ISP's decision to ban online study materials like PDF notes was a thoughtful step. Many students were getting distracted under the pretext of studying, and this initiative not only helped us minimize distractions but also allowed our minds to detox and focus better on our goals.
Secondly, I deeply admire the dedication of our teachers, especially Arun Sir and Harpreet Sir. Their commitment to our learning is unmatched—they ensure all our doubts are clarified, no matter how late it gets. Despite having to travel to different centers for other lectures, they never refused to help us.
Our Organic Chemistry Teacher, Siddharth Sir, treats us like his younger brother. He goes the extra mile to provide us with additional practice and clarity on concepts, ensuring we build a strong foundation.

Lastly, Imtiyaz Sir plays a crucial role in shaping not just our academics but also our mindset. He corrects our mistakes with patience, motivates us to do better, and shares valuable insights about life and the future.

I genuinely believe this institute is the best place to prepare for JEE and build a successful future. The dedication, discipline, and support provided here are truly commendable, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to every aspiring student.

featured_reviews.name: Aangi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honest Review by Aangi Jain – BW Batch, NEET 2025 Aspirant

I’m Aangi Jain from the BW Batch, and I appeared for NEET 2025 after three years of preparation with ISP. Based on my experience, I can confidently say that ISP not only teaches the syllabus thoroughly but also provides valuable post-NEET counseling guidance from highly experienced experts — something that most institutes don’t offer.

The faculty at ISP is top-notch, including qualified doctors, IITians, and NITians. The support staff is also very helpful and always ready to assist students when needed. One thing I truly appreciate is the institute's consistency in conducting weekly tests. No matter what, the tests are held regularly, and detailed post-test analysis is shared. This helps students understand their mistakes and work on continuous improvement.

Honestly speaking, success in NEET is a 50-50 partnership between the institute and the student. Teachers do their job — they teach, solve doubts, and guide — but at the end of the day, it’s up to the student to put in the self-study hours.

Sadly, I’ve seen some students who were not serious about their studies or future careers blaming and even bullying teachers online. These are often the same students who were regularly scolded by faculty and staff for poor performance. Frankly, I believe this is just a way to gain sympathy from their parents for not doing well academically.

I’d like to personally thank Imtiyaz Sir, who has always supported and encouraged me throughout my preparation. Yes, he might be late by 15–30 minutes sometimes, but has anyone considered why? Maybe he was handling a previous class that ran overtime, or he was in a meeting with a student’s parents discussing their academic performance. These things are part of the dedication and responsibility he takes on.

The internet should not be a platform for venting frustration against teachers or an institute just because you couldn’t perform well. If a student truly wants to succeed, they will — regardless of the challenges.

This is an honest and heartfelt review — not influenced by any gifts or rewards from ISP. I had a good NEET 2025 attempt and am currently in the Medical Admission Counseling process, aiming for a Government BDS seat. I’m hopeful and confident.

So yes: ISP + A Hardworking Student = SUCCESS
